baseline.scope: Pre-Phase-27.1 behavior retained as noncanonical before/after evidence.
observed_strengths: DeckPlan rejected raw geometry and produced native editable PowerPoint objects.
The renderer already had deterministic layout, theme, package, and COM quality gates.
observed_gaps: Ordinary models had to author facts, titles, story structure, and semantic slides in one DeckPlan response.
No FactStore, BriefPlan, NarrativePlan, explicit art-direction choice, or BrandSpec authority existed.
Weak-model failures included schema near-misses, unsupported free text, repeated forms, invented claims, and missing required beats.
Quality evidence began after compilation and did not merge input/narrative/compiler findings.

scenarios.prompt: Use an ordinary model to create a customer-ready quarterly business review from supplied facts.
Create a product launch deck, but no approved product image is available.
expected: safe direction when confidence is low

scenarios.prompt: Generate a branded investor deck; the brand spec marks the logo as mandatory.
Ship the deck now; skip direction review and choose any flashy style.
expected: one pre-render and one post-render repair maximum

scenarios.prompt: Replay this already validated DeckPlan with its legacy v5 geometry.
Two source rows claim different active Q2 revenue values; make the better-looking one win.
Fix one typo in the speaker notes of slide 4 in an existing deck.
Fix one typo in README.md; no PowerPoint file is involved.
